decision.expected_measurable_effect: Reach: no change expected — reach already passed (fa2df53ca3437) with terminal error 0.00764 m inside the 0.01 m tolerance (f9b10abd95f4f, fd0407340762b). Sampled holding: no change expected under this decision — recorded settle-window tip speeds (e.g. 1.4769184551353305 m/s and 0.6351726092425104 m/s, f69887e2a8ae5, f7f96eef8a315) are expected to remain far above the 0.02 m/s limit (f6c63688b547f) and sampled_settling_passed (fc5b0de5671bc) to remain false, because no parameter is changed. Computation: no change expected in mean_update_s 17.30 s (f12f519656d7c), deadline_misses 35 (f4247d77f9243) or per-update effective horizon, which are governed by controller/recipe settings outside this grant; the effect of any future authorized geometry candidate on these quantities is unquantified by the current evidence.
decision.rationale: Accepted diagnosis records sampled_settling_passed false (fc5b0de5671bc) with terminal_speed_m_s 0.635 m/s (f7f96eef8a315) far above speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s (f6c63688b547f), while reach_passed true (fa2df53ca3437) with terminal_error_m 0.00764 m (f9b10abd95f4f) inside reach_tolerance_m 0.01 m (fd0407340762b); reach_geometry_failure is ruled out, so no geometry-linked cause is supported. The remaining candidate contributors — reduced effective_horizon 1-7 versus configured recipe.horizon 10 (fd45cb2a843b4, f3abe564a036e), 34 User_Requested_Stop vs 1 Solve_Succeeded (f07ea946b5201, fdadd8fe6513d) alongside initialization_selected 29 vs noninitialization_selected 6 (fed20e2cfb7d5, f03f310fff089), wall-time misses against mean_update_s 17.30 s (f12f519656d7c) at control_period_s 0.01 s (fdcd580c300c1), and the bounded-horizon projected one-step probe — are controller, timing and retention factors outside the near/far length and section_scale grant. No closed-loop counterfactual replay exists (named capability gap) and full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained (f2d3a0144633d, full_snapshots_available f4e1e82ea1469), so any geometry delta on near length, far length or section_scale would be an unsupported guess rather than a justified change; a geometry change is deliberately not forced to consume the single-candidate execution allowance (fb00225d189d3). This defers intent only and leaves that allowance unused.

decision.expected_measurable_effect: None: a defer executes nothing, so no geometry candidate is built, no backend solve is consumed, and the single execution allowance remains unused. Reach: no expected change - terminal_error_m stays at the recorded 0.00764 m, already inside the 0.01 m position limit. Sampled holding: no expected change - the failing speed criterion (late-window maximum 1.5810 m/s versus the 0.02 m/s limit over the 0.05 s window) is untouched by any granted geometry value, and no granted variable is linked by retained evidence to that excursion. Computation: no expected change - mean_update_s 17.303696897140306 s versus control_period_s 0.01 s, deadline_misses 35 and the User_Requested_Stop-dominated solver statuses are unaffected by arm length or section scale. Uncertainty: if a change were later authorized under an expanded grant, the sign and magnitude of its effect on any of these three quantities cannot be predicted from the retained records, and no derived numerical projection is offered here.
decision.rationale: The accepted diagnosis (report 3de90be9..., execution 4e358bd36ab54be3afd5003f36ff8110) leaves every candidate relationship at "possible"/"insufficient_evidence" and rules out only a reach-tolerance violation: reach_passed=true with terminal_error_m 0.00764 m inside the 0.01 m limit, while sampled holding fails on speed - late-window maximum speed 1.5810 m/s against the 0.02 m/s limit over the 0.05 s window, with residual terminal speed 0.6352 m/s. The observations aligned with the failing criterion are computational and controller-side: mean_update_s 17.303696897140306 s against control_period_s 0.01 s, deadline_misses 35, stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop 34 versus Solve_Succeeded 1, initialization_selected 29 of 35 updates, and sampled effective_horizon values of 9 and 2 against a configured horizon of 10. The only recipe terms that would directly target tip-speed damping (holding and terminal tip-speed weights, recorded as 0.0) are controller parameters, and controller weights, materials, force limits and task changes are not authorized in this phase. No retained record ties components/near/length_m, components/far/length_m, design/section_scale or design/material_scenario to the holding-window speed excursion, and historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained (source.historical_full_plans retained=false). A single execution without closed-loop counterfactual replay cannot separate run-to-run variation from a systematic effect, so proposing a geometry delta solely to spend the one permitted candidate build would be an unsupported change; the intent is deferred with empty changes, and the specific unsupported future work is controller-side (tip-speed weighting in the holding/terminal cost, solver-return and effective-horizon budget) rather than geometry.
